talia: Heads-up — saw weird token shift in canary for halcyon-13b-int8-hybrid during streaming + longprefill. Repro steps below.
talia: Steps: 1) send 12k prompt as single prefill request, 2) immediately start streaming generation with interleaved small user messages, 3) observe output drift after ~9k tokens.
talia: Minimal repro curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"halcyon-13b-int8-hybrid","prefill":"<12k text>","stream":true}'
```

talia: Log snippet (short):
```
[2026-03-22 14:12:03] kv_cache: write ptr=0x7f3a... len=8192
[2026-03-22 14:12:03] streamer: started chunk #1 (user message)
[2026-03-22 14:12:04] kv_cache: write ptr reused -> overlap detected
[2026-03-22 14:12:05] generation: token_pos drift +4096
```

dave: Oof. Could be race in the async prefill path where shared KV buffer isn't pinned per session. Any chance the prefill and stream use same shard context ID?
dave: Which binary/commit on canary?
talia: canary build 2026-03-21-rc7 (runtime rev ae3f). Test job: canary-run-9812. Repro flaky but ~3/10 runs.
anya: Does this happen on q4v2 vs int8-hybrid? We saw different behavior earlier.
talia: Quick check: q4v2 shows same symptom but later (around 11k tokens). int8-hybrid fails earlier and with larger drift magnitude.
mohit: Looks like RoPE index math might be wrong when streaming chunks are applied mid-prefill. Possibly an off-by-N in base offset applied to the KV index when combining prefill vs in-flight cache updates.
mohit: Can you dump kv indices around the overlap? e.g., `kv_dump --range 8000:8200` and the rot-phase values.
talia: Attached small dump to S3: s3://redwood-canary/kv-dumps/canary-run-9812/kv-dump-0001.txt
ci-bot: Run 9812 - 3/10 failed. Flaky test triggered. See build link: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/9812
anya: Another thought — our streaming path compresses prefix entries when cache crosses shard boundary. Maybe quantized packing (int8 hybrid) changes alignment so we get partial entry writes.
anya: If prefill writes a packed kv entry then the streamer writes a smaller unaligned pack -> overwrite.
dave: For immediate triage: add per-request KV generation id (nonce) and assert no cross-session reuse. Also add a quick sync on shard boundary write.
talia: I'll add nonce and boundary-lock in runtime and rerun canary 10x.
mohit: If adding locks reduces throughput significantly, consider a lightweight compare-and-swap to validate before overwrite.
anya: Also add an eval script that runs longprefill + interleaved chat to keep reproducing. Put results in /tmp/longprefill-smoke.
talia: Will do. Posting updates shortly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
dave: Thanks. If you need help with kv_dump parsing I can script it.
ci-bot: Note: Incident created for canary instability: INC-2026-0319. Assigned: eng-ml.
mohit: tagging @dave for follow-up on RoPE index math.
anya: small nit — add token-level hash to the dump so we can see when tokens shift (quick diff).
talia: good idea, adding token-hash to dump now.
